thread:
Alex C: Hey finance team — my corporate card got declined when the airline tried to refund a canceled segment and now the refund isn't showing in Ramp. I need to file for reimbursement but Ramp says 'no card transactions found' :confused: Can someone advise?

Maya F: Hi Alex — can you DM me the last 4 of the card and the flight vendor name? We'll trace on our side. Also did you submit a manual expense or upload the receipt?

Alex C: Flight vendor: 'Skylane Airways'. Last 4: 4821. I uploaded the refund email and boarding pass to the expense conversation in Ramp but the system still shows a missing card txn. I tried to create a manual expense and it errors with "duplicate payment possible".

Finance Bot: Automated notice: If the corporate card provider (Ramp) shows no matching transaction, Finance Ops can create a manual reimbursement after verifying docs. Please include manager approval.

Roger H: @Alex C — I approve the manual reimbursement for the canceled segment. Leave the manager approval field as: "Roger H — manager approval" so Maya can proceed.

Maya F: Thanks @Roger H. Alex, two quick asks so we can process: 1) Upload the refund confirmation + any communication from Skylane. 2) Add a short note in Ramp explaining the decline and that manager approval is in thread. If you already uploaded, paste the Ramp expense URL here.

Alex C: Uploaded the refund email and a screenshot of the declined card message. Ramp expense URL: https://app.ramp.com/expenses/REDACTED/1768

Emma L: Quick question on per diem — Alex was traveling to Lisbon. The travel policy shows €60/day for meals, but Airbnb covered one dinner and he has a meal receipt for €85. Do we reimburse the full meal or cap at per diem?

Maya F: For international travel we reimburse actuals up to the per diem unless the employee had a client-hosted meal (which can exceed per diem if pre-approved). If the meal was personal or team dinner with no client, we cap to €60/day. Do you have a client name or note for that €85 receipt?

Alex C: It was a team dinner with product folks — no external client. No pre-approval. So I guess cap at €60 and I can mark the rest as personal.

Maya F: OK noted. For the manual reimbursement we'll: 1) create an expense for the refunded flight amount (full amount) since the card decline blocked it; 2) reimburse meal up to €60 and mark €25 as out-of-pocket non-reimbursable. We need your bank last 4 for the manual payout too (for verification).

Alex C: Bank last 4: 7810. Thanks.

Finance Bot: Automated workflow started: created ticket FIN-2026-342. Maya, please route to payroll for ACH if needed.

Maya F: I've created the manual reimbursement and attached all docs to FIN-2026-342. Roger, I flagged for approval (you already approved in thread) and routed to payments. Expect ACH in 3 business days. Please confirm once funds land and mark the Ramp expense as reimbursed.

Roger H: Confirmed. Thanks Maya.

Alex C: Thanks everyone — appreciate the quick help :thumbsup:. I'll check bank and report back here.

Emma L: Small note for policy — we should add a help tip in the travel docs about 'card-declined refunds' and how to request manual reimbursements. I've created a doc stub in Notion, will ping ops to expand.

Maya F: Good idea Emma. I'll add a snippet to the travel guide with the Ramp steps, required fields, and the ticketing SLA.

Alex C: Update — got the ACH today, all good. Marking as resolved.

Finance Bot: FIN-2026-342 status: Closed.

Maya F: Awesome — thanks for confirming Alex. Closing out on our side.
